metadata.title: Menu | Atzomx Café — Downtown Oaxaca
metadata.description: Specialty coffee, frappés, chilaquiles, bowls, smoothies and more at Atzomx. Full menu from the coworking café in downtown Oaxaca.

banner.title: Menu
banner.tagline: Specialty coffee, bowls and more — made at the heart of the coworking space.

categoryNotes.sandwiches: Served with house salad or potato chips.

coworkingNote.title: Coming to work?
coworkingNote.text: This space is for you. With a minimum purchase at the café you get 2 hours on the ground floor (applies only to those who come to work). After that, the coworking service fee applies. This helps us keep the warmth and comfort you deserve. Thank you for understanding!
